items.title: File Widerspruch against reimbursement denial
items.quote: Widerspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Schreibens bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse möglich, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The one-month Widerspruch period runs from the deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) of this letter under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X (statutory health insurers are social-law bodies, so the 4-day delivery rule applies without weekend/holiday shift of the delivery day itself). However, the letter carries no printed date and no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date, so the posting day - and therefore the delivery day and the one-month period - cannot be established. No due date can be computed from the information given.

warnings: The letter has no visible document date (no date field, no 'zur Post gegeben am' notice), so the posting/delivery day and thus the one-month Widerspruch deadline cannot be computed; the user should check the envelope postmark or the original letter for a date and count one month from four days after that.
No amounts of money are mentioned in this rejection letter, which is expected since it denies reimbursement rather than granting or demanding a payment.
